name: PrintBrm.exe
author: Elliot Killick

commands.description: Create a ZIP file from a folder in a remote drive
commands.usecase: Exfiltrate the contents of a remote folder on a UNC share into a zip file
commands.os: Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Extract the contents of a ZIP file stored in an Alternate Data Stream (ADS) and store it in a folder
commands.usecase: Decompress and extract a ZIP file stored on an alternate data stream to a new folder
commands.os: Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

detection: PrintBrm.exe should not be run on a normal workstation
